source_locators.locator: Supplied PDF p. 1, Typical procedure, solution A

recipe_inventory.scope: One separate source-defined solvent branch; washing and50°C vacuum drying are workup, not another CdS growth variant.
gaps: Both supplied main article pages, two figures, five proposed reaction equations and twenty-four references read. SI and cited full texts unreviewed.
Room temperature and ambient pressure are reported qualitatively; no numerical temperature/pressure is assigned. Flasks have covers; no sealed-pressure reactor or hydrothermal operation is asserted.

Conical-flask capacity, cover design, sonication-bath make/model, actual delivered acoustic intensity, cooling-water flow/temperature, purge duration/flow, mixing, pH and reaction yield are unreported. Ar purging occurs before irradiation; a continuous Ar atmosphere during all seven hours is not asserted.
Precipitate collection method, wash volumes/cycle counts, vacuum level, product storage and exact physical aliquot identities across measurements are unreported.

Scherrer crystallite sizes (5.3 nm A, 3.5 nm B) and approximate TEM particle sizes (8 nm A, 5 nm B) are separate method-specific quantities. No uncertainty, numerical size-distribution width or statistical sample count is supplied.
XPS composition and purity are qualitative; spectra are explicitly not shown and no stoichiometric ratio or impurity limit is reported.

The source mechanism is proposed and includes literature-based radical chemistry; intermediates, rates and solution speciation are not measured. No model coordinates or current optical/electronic property measurements are supplied.
Exact molecular, particle and crystal presentation remains pending; any generic molecular references and authored apparatus are explanatory, not source-measured geometry.

The concluding sentence on p. 345 reverses the with/without-isopropyl-alcohol order relative to the explicit A/B preparation, Figure 1 caption and detailed phase assignments. Preserve sample A = water = hexagonal and sample B = water/isopropyl alcohol = cubic from the detailed sample-linked evidence; retain this conclusion conflict rather than silently correcting the source.

source_notes.label: Crystallite and particle sizes describe different measurements
source_notes.summary: Sample A has a reported Scherrer crystallite size of 5.3 nm and a TEM particle size of about 8 nm; sample B has 3.5 nm and around 5 nm, respectively. The source initially calls these consistent and later notes the TEM values are slightly larger. No exact equivalence, combined average, confidence interval or numerical distribution width is inferred.
source_locators: Supplied PDF p. 1, Scherrer paragraph; p. 2, TEM paragraph

source_notes.label: Solvent effects and radical pathways are proposed
source_notes.summary: The authors associate isopropyl alcohol with reduced aggregation and altered CdS phase selection, and propose different radical-mediated routes to sulfide from thiosulfate. The reaction equations and kinetic explanation are source interpretation. No measured radical concentration, intermediate yield or comparative rate constant is supplied.
source_locators: Supplied PDF p. 2, proposed reactions 1–5 and mechanism
